Subject: Re: Fwd: Outstanding invoice — INV-20261112-749 (NovaBio)

Thanks Marcus — I’ll take point. Quick notes / recommended next steps:

1) VAT reissue: We can reissue to NovaBio EU but need confirmation of their EU VAT registration number and legal entity name. If they supply that by EOD tomorrow we’ll reissue a corrected invoice (no change in total due).
2) Short-term collection proposal: request a 30% immediate wire to demonstrate good faith, with the remaining 70% split over two subsequent payments (30% + 40%) within 45 days.
3) Dunning cadence if no commitment: 3 business day reminder -> final demand (legal) after 14 days -> escalate to Credit Committee for a formal hold/termination if no contact after 21 days.
4) Customer-suggested PO cycle is 45 days; if they insist on full 45d terms, we accept but will place the account on credit-watch and remove trial / any free overages until cleared.

I recommend we offer a commercial concession only if Finance signs off — suggest an early-payment credit (5% on the outstanding balance) if they commit to 60% within 7 days. Laura / Marcus, make the commercial call on concession; I need Finance confirmation for the write-off/credit policy.

I’ll prepare the reissued invoice template and the short payment agreement to send to NovaBio. If we don’t see a commitment by next Thursday I’ll move to Credit Committee.

Attachment: SLA-term-sheet.pdf (for reference)

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Head of Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
